dataset_or_information_needed: Verified point coordinates for every station in cng_stations.csv
attempted_sources: Gujarat Energy official CNG directory; HPCL official CNG directory; secondary CNGbunk station pages; OSM-derived WhereFUEL index
information_sought: Reliable latitude/longitude tied to the exact station name/address and separate coordinate-source provenance
result: Official operator directories provide addresses but not point geometry. Secondary coordinate pages yielded several distinct candidate points, but some pages explicitly warn that CNG dispensing is unconfirmed and some other records reuse generic coordinates. Candidate coordinates are stored separately, not copied into the station master. Two secondary candidate pages also carry an Adani CNG label whereas the matching primary station rows were extracted from the Gujarat Energy directory; this operator/brand discrepancy has not been resolved.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: No coordinate candidate was independently confirmed against an authoritative map/operator point or a processed GIS layer in this run.
effect_on_project: No verified map pins; distance-based nearby-station calculations and geographic diversion analysis must not use the primary inventory yet. Two station records also need operator/brand attribution reconciled before using them for operator-specific network comparisons.
recommended_next_step: Confirm each location with the official operator locator or geocode using a suitable authoritative map workflow; inspect the map pin/address; store its coordinate source URL and retain only validated points. For Visat Automobile and Sharada Petroleum Services, explicitly confirm operator/brand identity as part of coordinate validation.

dataset_or_information_needed: Current Ahmedabad urban boundary / ward polygon and point-in-polygon validation
attempted_sources: DataMeet Ahmedabad municipal spatial data landing page and its advertised Wards.geojson; city address/locality descriptions in station directories
information_sought: A dated AMC boundary consistent with the project’s urban study area and a repeatable method to test each station point
result: A candidate Wards.geojson was found on the DataMeet landing page, which states CC BY 4.0; the geometry was not loaded/processed in the current package build.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: Boundary geometry version and exact feature boundaries were not machine-validated against the candidate coordinates.
effect_on_project: Study-area inclusion is based on address/locality screening, with the Ognaj/SP Ring Road row marked uncertain; this is not a spatially verified completeness claim.
recommended_next_step: Download a suitable dated AMC boundary, retain attribution, inspect its CRS and polygons, then point-in-polygon test validated coordinates.

dataset_or_information_needed: Complete current named CNG station inventory across all operators within Ahmedabad urban area
attempted_sources: Gujarat Energy official directory; HPCL official CNG outlet directory; Adani Total Gas CNG page/Locate CNG Station link; WhereFUEL/OSM-derived city page; secondary station pages
information_sought: All currently operating CNG stations by operator with exact address, CNG dispensing status, and verifiable coordinates
result: Two city-locality records were extracted from Gujarat Energy and ten Ahmedabad-address records from HPCL. Adani’s official page exposes a Locate CNG Station link, but a clean Ahmedabad station table was not retrieved. Secondary sources contain contradictory CNG-status signals. The 12-row master is a sourced subset, not complete network census.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: Public sources viewed did not yield a reconciled, current, cross-operator inventory with coordinate-level verification.
effect_on_project: Map coverage and candidate ranking could omit stations; no total station count is inferred from this list.
recommended_next_step: Use Adani locator interactively or request a current list from each authorized operator, cross-check all records, deduplicate, and validate boundaries.

dataset_or_information_needed: Ahmedabad/RTO vehicle registrations by fuel type over time
attempted_sources: Parivahan Vahan Public Dashboard and Vahan Public Report pages
information_sought: Ahmedabad-specific Natural Gas/CNG registration count by vehicle class and period; clear new-vs-cumulative definitions
result: The official portal exposes State, RTO, fuel, category, status and time filters, including Natural Gas. No reproducible Ahmedabad-specific export was saved in this run; no counts are included.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: Dashboard filter widgets were visible, but a reliable tabular city/RTO extract was not retrieved and saved.
effect_on_project: No real CNG vehicle-demand covariate for candidate ranking or long-term scenarios.
recommended_next_step: Export a filter-defined report for the relevant Ahmedabad RTO(s), preserve query parameters/reporting period, and distinguish new registrations from cumulative active vehicles.

attempted_sources: Gujarat Energy and HPCL official public station directories; PPAC/PNGRB public pages reviewed
information_sought: Historical kg dispensed per station per day/hour, station IDs and data-quality notes
result: No station-level sales transaction history was available from public pages reviewed. Synthetic data was generated for workflow testing.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: Operational sales are not published in the retrieved directory/statistical pages; access likely requires operator authorization.
effect_on_project: Forecasting can be demonstrated on simulation data only; model performance cannot be claimed for real stations.
recommended_next_step: Request authorized historical data from Gujarat Gas/other operators; retain source dates, units, time zone, missingness and corrections.

dataset_or_information_needed: Actual planned supply, deliveries, inventories and stockout history
attempted_sources: Public operator pages and official sector portals reviewed alongside station directory research
information_sought: Daily planned available supply per station and relevant actual delivery/inventory/outage records
result: No station-day supply or inventory records were found in the retrieved public sources. `synthetic_supply.csv` is an explicitly simulated comparison scenario.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: The required data is operational and was not present in the public pages retrieved.
effect_on_project: Alerts are illustrative potential-planning-shortfall demonstrations, not evidence of real stockout risk.
recommended_next_step: Obtain a supply-plan export from the operator and agree the definition of planned available supply before validation.

dataset_or_information_needed: Official Gujarat holidays and local events for the full 2024-2025 simulation period
attempted_sources: Official holiday calendars were considered during research; no dated Gujarat holiday file was downloaded into this package
source_urls: https://gad.gujarat.gov.in/ (departmental portal; exact 2024/2025 calendar export not retrieved)
information_sought: Verified public holiday dates and scope for Ahmedabad/Gujarat during 2024 and 2025
result: No official_holidays.csv is included. The synthetic daily generator leaves public-holiday and event fields blank unless a sourced optional file is supplied.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: A complete, source-backed two-year holiday table was not retrieved and validated in this run.
effect_on_project: The simulated series does not intentionally encode specific holiday/event spikes.
recommended_next_step: Add only a sourced holiday calendar with URL, geography and publication period, then rerun the generator.

dataset_or_information_needed: Road accessibility, traffic, service capacity, land-use/demand indicators for candidate locations
attempted_sources: No complete, matched station/candidate-level GIS indicators were retrieved in this pass
source_urls: Not obtained as a usable dataset
information_sought: Travel-time/accessibility, population/vehicle-demand proxies, road-network connectivity, land-use context, zoning/land eligibility, dispenser capacity and service times
result: No such indicators are included as facts. These are identified as future inputs rather than fabricated fields.
reason_unavailable_or_unsuitable: No consistent city-scale dataset with validated geographic alignment and sufficient provenance was assembled.
effect_on_project: Distance alone cannot justify a candidate ranking; the impact simulator must remain assumption-based until this context is added.
recommended_next_step: Obtain licensed GIS/transport data and operator/site constraints; define ranking weights transparently and expose assumptions in the UI.
